items.quote: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people
items.claim: God Almighty blesses the addressee, makes them fruitful, and multiplies them

items.quote: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee
items.claim: God Almighty gives the blessing of Abraham to the addressee and their seed
God gave the land to Abraham

items.quote: that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham
items.claim: The addressee will inherit the land
